en: Monochrome postcard-style image showing a large, angular institutional building on a street corner. The architecture is rectilinear with minimal ornament, rounded-arch windows on the upper floor, a prominent external staircase on the side, and an arched main entrance framed by rusticated stone blocks. A shield or coat-of-arms panel is placed above the main doorway. To the right, a slightly lower wing with arcades and rows of arched windows extends along the street. The scene is quiet with empty streets and a small planted area with a tree and lampposts in front of the building.
